claims.claim: Elections B.C. declared Conservative David Xie the winner in Burnaby South-Metrotown by 64 votes over NDP incumbent Paul Choi.
claims.episode_span: declared Conservative David Xie the winner in Burnaby South-Metrotown, 64 votes ahead of NDP incumbent Paul Choi
claims.source_title: Recount flips squeaker election night win for NDP in Burnaby South-Metrotown to Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: After the recount and adding mail-in votes during the final vote count, Elections B.C. declared Conservative David Xie the winner in Burnaby South-Metrotown, with 64 more votes than the NDP’s Paul Choi, who had won the seat in 2024.

claims.claim: The incoming Conservative majority is 64 of 93 seats, and the Vancouver Sun reported the party will control almost 70 per cent of the next legislature under premier-designate Lorne Doerkson.
claims.episode_span: the flip takes the incoming majority to 64 of 93 seats, and that under premier-designate Lorne Doerkson the Conservatives will control almost 70 per cent
claims.source_title: Recount flips squeaker election night win for NDP in Burnaby South-Metrotown to Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: B.C.’s incoming majority government grew by another seat — to 64 out of a possible 93 — when a Burnaby seat just barely held by the NDP was snatched by the Conservatives after a recount.

claims.claim: Choi led by 66 ballots on election night, a 0.5 per cent margin, and the final margin was 0.43 per cent.
claims.episode_span: Choi’s election-night lead was 66 ballots, a 0.5 per cent margin; the final margin was 0.43 per cent
claims.source_title: Recount flips squeaker election night win for NDP in Burnaby South-Metrotown to Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: A recount of NDP’s election night 66-ballot win in Burnaby South-Metrotown flipped the seat to the Tories.

claims.claim: Stephanie Higginson held Ladysmith-Oceanside by 50 votes after a 13-vote election-night lead, and Kristina Loewen held Kelowna Centre by 43 votes after a recount narrowed a 137-vote lead.
claims.episode_span: Higginson’s lead grew from 13 votes on election night to 50 in the final count
claims.source_title: Recount flips squeaker election night win for NDP in Burnaby South-Metrotown to Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: In Ladysmith-Oceanside, the NDP’s Stephanie Higginson had her voting margin increased to 50 votes in the final count and she held her seat.

claims.claim: Elections B.C. completed the final count Sunday, adding one Conservative seat and sending two close calls to judicial recounts.
claims.episode_span: Elections B.C. completed the final count Sunday
claims.source_title: Vaughn Palmer: Conservatives flip another seat in final Elections B.C. tally
claims.supporting_quote: Elections B.C. completed the final count for the 2026 election Sunday, adding one seat for the B.C. Conservatives and sending two close calls to judicial recounts.

claims.claim: Forecasters say some southwest B.C. areas could receive more than 250 millimetres of rain, and North Shore News linked a second death to the wild weather.
claims.episode_span: some areas could receive more than 250 millimetres
claims.source_title: Orange warnings raised over next B.C. deluge, as second death linked to wild weather
claims.supporting_quote: Forecasters are escalating rainfall warnings in southwest British Columbia, saying some areas could receive a deluge topping 250 millimetres in a new parade of storms that is set to drench the region.

claims.claim: Power has been restored to most B.C. Hydro customers, and another storm series is expected from Tuesday through Thursday.
claims.episode_span: Power is back for most B.C. Hydro customers ahead of the next round
claims.source_title: B.C. wind storm: Power restored to most customers in time for next round of wild weather
claims.supporting_quote: Another "strong and potent" series of storms is expected to start on Tuesday and lasting through Thursday

claims.claim: A third storm is heading for the B.C. coast after a weekend that knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead.
claims.episode_span: the third storm in the series is heading for the coast after a weekend that knocked out power to thousands
claims.source_title: Another storm expected for B.C. coast after wet, windy weekend
claims.supporting_quote: The third in a series of storms is heading for British Columbia, after wild weather knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead over the weekend.

claims.claim: B.C. Hydro said Prince George power may not be fully restored until Tuesday after a Friday night windstorm.
claims.episode_span: B.C. Hydro said power there may not be fully restored until Tuesday
claims.source_title: Impact of Prince George windstorm still being felt, homeowners face long waits to get trees removed
claims.supporting_quote: B.C. Hydro says it may be until Tuesday before power is fully restored, and tree cleanup is underway at parks and properties throughout the community.

claims.claim: A 78-year-old woman died after being struck by a Lexus sedan at about 11 a.m. on November 6 while crossing Dunbar Street at West 34th Avenue in an unmarked crosswalk.
claims.episode_span: A 78-year-old woman died after a Lexus sedan struck her while she crossed Dunbar Street
claims.source_title: 78-year-old pedestrian dies after being struck during heavy rainstorm
claims.supporting_quote: The incident occurred at about 11 a.m. on November 6 at the intersection of Dunbar Street and West 34th Avenue.

claims.claim: The pedestrian death was Vancouver’s 13th fatal traffic collision of the year, and no charges have been laid.
claims.episode_span: it was Vancouver’s 13th fatal traffic collision of the year
claims.source_title: 78-year-old pedestrian dies after being struck during heavy rainstorm
claims.supporting_quote: The investigation is ongoing, and no charges have been laid at this time. This incident marks Vancouvers 13th fatal traffic collision of the year.

claims.claim: Vancouver police launched Project Vigilance and said officers will target speeding, distracted driving, impaired driving, jaywalking and lack of helmets.
claims.episode_span: officers will target speeding, distracted driving, impaired driving, jaywalking and lack of helmets
claims.source_title: Vancouver police issue advisory after woman dies in e-scooter crash
claims.supporting_quote: We’ll be targeting speeding, distracted driving, impaired driving, jaywalking, and lack of helmets, among other behaviours that can cause harm,” Donaldson said

claims.claim: Kristopher John Hayward, 55, was charged with second-degree murder after a 52-year-old woman was found dead on November 6 in the 46000 block of Mellard Avenue.
claims.episode_span: Kristopher John Hayward, 55, has been charged with second-degree murder
claims.source_title: Chilliwack man, 55, charged with 2nd-degree murder of woman
claims.supporting_quote: The next day, Kristopher John Hayward, 55, was charged with second-degree murder by the BC Prosecution Service.

claims.claim: Noel Booth Elementary in Brookswood was closed all day Monday after vandalism found inside the school, and Langley RCMP are investigating.
claims.episode_span: the school was closed to students for the full day Monday
claims.source_title: Langley police investigating after vandalism prompts all-day school closure
claims.supporting_quote: “Langley RCMP are investigating the incident. The district will be sharing an update with families later today,” said Abshire.

claims.claim: Paramveer Singh Deol, 18, of Surrey, was charged after police found a loaded firearm in a white Porsche stopped for accelerating through a red light, and he remains in custody awaiting a bail hearing.
claims.episode_span: Paramveer Singh Deol, has been charged after Surrey police said they stopped a white Porsche
claims.source_title: Man charged after loaded handgun found during traffic stop: Surrey police
claims.supporting_quote: Paramveer Singh Deol, a resident of Surrey, has been charged with multiple offences, including failing to stop for police, occupying a vehicle with a firearm inside, possession of a loaded firearm without a licence, and careless transport of a firearm, 9mm pistol.

claims.claim: The 2027 federal budget includes almost $30 billion to eliminate homelessness within 10 years and $15 billion to triple annual non-market housing starts to 24,000.
claims.episode_span: almost $30 billion aimed at eliminating homelessness within 10 years and $15 billion to triple annual non-market housing starts to 24,000
claims.source_title: Kelowna MP Stephen Fuhr speaks on federal budget to ‘end homelessness’
claims.supporting_quote: On Nov. 5, the federal government tabled its 2027 budget, which includes almost $30 billion dedicated to the goal of eliminating homelessness within the next decade, as well as $15 billion to triple the number of annual non-market housing starts to 24,000.

claims.claim: Pacific Blue Cross members can vote daily until November 24 to direct an extra $50,000 to a Richmond autism network’s independence programs.
claims.episode_span: Pacific Blue Cross members can vote daily until November 24 to direct an extra $50,000
claims.source_title: Richmond autism network gets funding for independence programs
claims.supporting_quote: Pacific Blue Cross members can vote daily until Nov. 24 to direct an extra $50,000.

claims.claim: Joey Saputo said Monday that if CF Montreal does not find a local buyer and an offer requires relocation, he will take that decision.
claims.episode_span: If the club doesn’t find a local buyer and I get an offer where the club needs to be relocated, then I have no choice.
claims.source_title: Vancouver Whitecaps aren't the only Canadian MLS team in danger of relocating to United States
claims.supporting_quote: “If the club doesn’t find a local buyer and I get an offer where the club needs to be relocated, then I have no choice,” Saputo told reporters. “That is the decision I will take.”

claims.claim: The Whitecaps have been for sale nearly two years, reached the MLS Cup Final last year, and this season posted a franchise-record 64 points on a 19-8-7 record.
claims.episode_span: This season they set a franchise record of 64 points, with a Western Conference-leading record of 19 wins, 8 losses and 7 draws.
claims.source_title: Vancouver Whitecaps aren't the only Canadian MLS team in danger of relocating to United States
claims.supporting_quote: The Whitecaps reached the MLS Cup Final last year, and this season has set a franchise record for points (64), after posting a Western Conference-leading 19-8-7 record.

claims.claim: A missing Ma’amtagila Nation father was last seen canoeing 85 kilometres northwest of Campbell River.
claims.episode_span: last seen canoeing in ocean waters 85 kilometres northwest of Campbell River
claims.source_title: Community-led search for missing Ma’amtagila Nation man amplifies, family says resources still needed
claims.supporting_quote: Community resources for a family-led search have intensified for a missing Ma’amtagila Nation father last seen canoeing in ocean waters 85 kilometres northwest of Campbell River, B.C., on Vancouver Island.
